releases.body:
### OpenCode Guardian v0.13.0 Release Notes

- **Streaming Loop Hardening & Bounded Watcher:** `StreamLoopWatcher` in `src/stream-loop.ts` shared across both OpenCode V1 and V2 host adapters.
- **V1 Stream Tracking:** Inspects `message.part.updated` strictly for active assistant messages; automatically disables inspection upon user turn start, assistant completion, or session idle/interruption.
- **V2 Stream Tracking:** Natively consumes `session.text.started|delta|ended` and `session.reasoning.started|delta|ended` events with incremental delta concatenation (2,048-char bounded tail).
- **Rule Configuration Semantics:** Full support for `error`, `warn`, and `off` rule severities in string or object form (`{ severity: 'warn' }`); `warn` mode logs warnings and dispatches advisory toast notifications without interrupting output.
- **Concurrency & Project Isolation:** Per-response mutex locks prevent duplicate interrupt calls on simultaneous parts; V2 event ingestion continues non-blocking during asynchronous project resolution.
- **Timeout & Retry Gating:** Adds 3-second interrupt timeout (`AbortSignal.timeout(3000)`); bounded retry allows at most three attempts per response on continued stream growth, suppressing overlapping retries on ambiguous timeouts.
- **Quoted Literal Fixture Protection:** Excludes short quoted numeric and hex literals (15–128 characters) from low-entropy and cycle false positives, preventing legitimate test hashes from triggering blocks.
- **Extended Period Support:** Detects longer periodic sentence structures up to 512 UTF-16 code units within the 2,048-character inspection window.
- **Telemetry & TUI Status:** Introduces `stream-interrupt-requested` audit event, toast notifications, and TUI status indicator (`▲ stream stop requested`).
- **781 Tests Passing:** 16 new stream-loop hardening tests added, 0 warnings, 0 lint errors, 18/18 smoke and integration tests verified.

### OpenCode Guardian v0.12.5 Release Notes

- **Degenerative Reasoning & Text Loop Breaker:** Language-agnostic detection (`detectDegenerativeLoop` in `src/degeneration.ts`) of runaway model repetition cycles (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash *'Hmm...'*, Kimi repeating Chinese/Japanese token cascades, runaway punctuation, code repeat loops like *'None, None, None...'*, and low-entropy babble collapse).
- **In-Flight Live Streaming Abort:** Real-time stream interceptor on `message.part.updated` events in both V1 and V2 host adapters immediately invokes `client.session.abort` or `context.session.interrupt` after $\ge 40$ chars of detected loop growth ($< 0.02$ ms execution overhead), preventing thousands of wasted generation tokens.
- **Circuit Breaker Turn Inspection:** `runtime/circuit-breaker` inspects assistant text and reasoning parts, emitting structured findings and actionable remediation directives.
- **Negative False-Positive Protections:** Exempts Markdown table rows (`|---|---|`), comment banners (`// ===`), hash dividers, fixture arrays, and standard code loops.
- **765 Tests Passing:** 24 new regression tests covering multilingual positive cases, negative exemptions, circuit breaker tripping, and V1/V2 streaming aborts.

releases.name: v0.12.4 — Source audit fixes, boundary hardening and native write support
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v0.12.4

- **Native Write Recognition:** Recognize native `write` tool payloads in preflight and telemetry categories; reject hardcoded credentials and source truncation placeholders while allowing safe file writes.
- **V2 Session Directory Resolution:** Resolve the active session directory before V2 tool preflight and before-edit observation, ensuring multi-project environments evaluate strict per-project configuration without guessing directories from incomplete creation events.
- **V2 Auxiliary Model Guard Isolation:** Install V2 auxiliary model guards independently of the initial project's secret setting and evaluate effective settings per request; support dynamic config updates and clean disposer teardown.
- **Connection String Secret Redaction:** Redact connection-string passwords with empty usernames or absent paths (including Redis, MySQL, Postgres URLs) while preserving URI structure and surrounding punctuation.
- **Replacement Edit and Deletion Tracking:** Record structured replacement edits (including empty replacement and deletion operations) and individual affected paths as mutations in evidence tracking, ensuring stale test executions cannot satisfy post-change verification requirements.
- **Patch Dependency Inspection:** Inspect each patch file independently for undeclared dependencies (`no-ghost-deps`), retaining each file's language and nearest manifest boundaries across mixed-language and documentation edits.
- **Expanded Test Coverage:** Added 10 new regression tests in `tests/source-audit-fixes.test.mjs`, raising automated test coverage from 731 to 741 tests.

### Verification
- **Automated Tests:** 741 / 741 PASS
- **Typecheck:** Strict mode 0 errors
- **Linter:** 0 warnings, 0 errors
- **End-to-End Sandbox:** 18 / 18 scenarios PASS
- **Documentation:** 8 / 8 files verified with valid links and accessible SVG

releases.name: v0.12.3 — Multilingual In-Progress Protection & Subagent Completion Gate Hardening
releases.body:
## 0.12.3 — 2026-10-21

- **Multilingual in-progress detection across all 13 supported international locales:** Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, English, and Turkish.
- **Subagent progress protection:** Subagents reporting ongoing progress in any supported language (e.g. *"en progreso"*, *"trabajo en curso"*, *"en cours"*, *"in Bearbeitung"*, *"в процессе"*, *"قيد التنفيذ"*, *"काम जारी है"*, *"进行中"*, *"進行中"*, *"진행 중"*, *"sedang berlangsung"*, *"işlem devam ediyor"*, *"in progress"*) are recognized with `isInProgress === true` and `isClosing === false`, eliminating false-positive completion gate blocking.
- **Orchestrator delegation support:** Prevents false-positive blocks when an orchestrator delegates work to a child subagent or waits for child execution.
- **Actionable numbered remediation prompts:** Restructures all 14 rule remediation prompts with standardized, numbered `ACTION REQUIRED:` directives.
- **Anti-distraction directive:** Forbids agents from reading, modifying, or exploring Guardian's own plugin files or internal audit logs during remediation.
- **Automated test suite:** 731 / 731 tests passing, 18 / 18 sandbox scenarios, standard and strict TypeScript checks pass, 0 linter warnings or errors.

Validation on Node 24.22.0: 731 tests, standard/strict TypeScript checks, lint, smoke test and 18 simulated scenarios passed. Package metadata and documentation identify v0.12.3.
